segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi Maya. It's Northline Supply, and the email is dana.miller@northlinesupply.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have Northline Supply pulled up in the admin console. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add four seats for the operations team. We're at 28 now, need to go to 32, ideally today if that's possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, that's straightforward. Your current plan is $42 per seat per month, billed monthly, and adding four seats today will prorate $96.80 for the rest of the April billing period. Is that okay to apply?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, that's fine. And can you send the receipt to me and copy ap@northlinesupply.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I'm updating the seat count now. Okay, you're at 32 seats, effective immediately. The billing tool generated invoice 48173 for $96.80, and I sent it to you with AP copied.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything else before I invite the new users?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you're all set. You can invite them from Users, then Add user in the admin console. If they don't see the invite within a minute or two, have them check spam, but it usually lands right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. That's all I needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Happy to help. Have a good one.
